evidence.claim: Customer reported: Customer C02354 message: 'I never made this $39.08 purchase. Please check my card.' Refers to 3491361.
Customer C02354 reported unrecognized in-person transaction 3491361 for $39.08 in region 126, stating they never made the purchase.

Holder C02354-K2|126|-185 has 11 of 13 prior transactions confirmed fraudulent across closed cases CC-0631, CC-1450, CC-2589, CC-3537, CC-4436, CC-4721, and CC-4942, establishing that this holder identity represents a compromised counterfeit card clone.

In the current burst between 2016-11-24 and 2016-11-27, holder C02354-K2|126|-185 executed three in-person transactions in region 126 totaling $124.08: transaction 3484403 for $44.04, transaction 3485990 for $40.96 with a 0.953 model score, and flagged transaction 3491361 for $39.08.

Prior closed cases on card C02354-K2, including CC-4942, CC-4721, and CC-4436, confirmed fraud under pattern out_of_region_use where the cardholder retained the card while cloned in-person purchases occurred in region 126.
The flagged transaction does not match any recurring charge schedule for holder C02354-K2|126|-185, with fewer than two prior similar charges.

case.summary: Customer C02354 reported an unauthorized in-person transaction of $39.08 (3491361) on card C02354-K2 in billing region 126. Historical analysis confirms that holder identity C02354-K2|126|-185 is compromised, with 11 of 13 past transactions confirmed fraudulent across seven closed cases (including CC-4436, CC-4721, and CC-4942) under an out-of-region card cloning pattern. Between November 24 and November 27, 2016, a burst of three card-present transactions totaling $124.08 was executed in region 126, including transaction 3485990 with a high model score of 0.953. The alert was confirmed as out_of_region_use fraud with a 0.95 probability, leading to the card being blocked and a fraud case created.

stop_reason: The investigation concluded under policy section 6 because decisive probability (0.95) was reached with multiple independent lines of evidence, including the customer's direct denial of the charge, a burst of out-of-region card-present activity with model scores up to 0.953, and extensive confirmation of fraud on the same holder identity across seven prior closed cases. Further investigative steps would not alter the outcome.
